name: mach-nho-conversation-memory
description: Local-first personal conversation memory web app

scripts.check: node --check public/app.js && node --check public/sw.js && node --check public/memory-bridge.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const p of ['public/index.html','public/styles.css','public/memory-bridge.js','public/manifest.webmanifest','public/icon.svg','README.md']) {if(!fs.existsSync(p)||!fs.statSync(p).size) throw new Error('Missing/empty file: '+p)}; const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('public/manifest.webmanifest','utf8')); if(!m.name||!m.start_url) throw new Error('Invalid PWA manifest'); console.log('Static app checks passed')"
scripts.serve: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const root=path.resolve('public');const types={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json','.webmanifest':'application/manifest+json','.svg':'image/svg+xml'};http.createServer((q,s)=>{let p=path.resolve(root,'.'+decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]));if(!p.startsWith(root)){s.writeHead(403).end();return}if(p===root)p=path.join(root,'index.html');fs.readFile(p,(e,b)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404).end('Not found');return}s.writeHead(200,{'content-type':types[path.extname(p)]||'application/octet-stream','cache-control':'no-cache'});s.end(b)})}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('Mạch Nhớ tại http://localhost:8080'))"
